expected.title: 2026 Cornell Atkinson Graduate Research Symposium
expected.notes:
The Cornell Atkinson Center for Sustainability will host a symposium to showcase research supported by Graduate Research Grants. 2027 applications are due Nov. 17, 2026.

Prospective applicants are encouraged to attend:

Thursday, October 29, 2026, 1-5 p.m.
121 Atkinson Hall
Highlighting research by Cornell Ph.D. students which aligns with our four priority areas.
